author: TeIq
content:
**Design doc**: .design/mod-policy-workbook.md
**Implements**: REQ-C1..C4, REQ-D4 (browse); AC-4

**Files to add**:
- polaris-backend/src/api/admin_policies/{mod,dto,handlers}.rs
- polaris-backend/src/api/policies/{mod,handlers}.rs (read-only)

**Endpoints**:
Admin (Role::Admin):
- GET    /api/policies                          list (scope, autonomy_mode, q filters)
- GET    /api/policies/:identifier              current version
- GET    /api/policies/:identifier/history      version chain
- GET    /api/policies/:identifier/:version     specific historical version
- GET    /api/admin/policies/:identifier/diff?from=N&to=M
- POST   /api/admin/policies                    create
- PATCH  /api/admin/policies/:identifier        amend (change_summary required)
- POST   /api/admin/policies/:identifier/pause  set autonomous_paused_until
- DELETE /api/admin/policies/:identifier/pause  clear pause

Moderator (Role::Moderator):
- GET    /api/policies, GET /api/policies/:identifier (shared route, RBAC layer gates fields)

**Rust quality**:
- Mirror polaris-backend/src/api/admin_moderators.rs (RBAC extractor pattern, ApiError shape)
- serde validation at the API boundary; reject invalid autonomy_mode etc before reaching the repo
- Errors map to polaris-backend/src/api/error.rs::ApiError

**Tests**:
- tests/admin_policies_endpoint.rs — full CRUD round-trip; non-admin 403; history order; pause/resume cycle

**Blocked by**: #223
